title: Same character, two outfits: a first look at My City for Kommersant
author: 1Life_Architect
selftext:
I’m on the team behind Kommersant, a free Android life sim. We used AI to help with code and some of the art. When it came to outfits, we kept the same base character and used separate SVG layers for the shirts. That made it easier to compare the colors on a small screen without the character changing underneath. The security job still shows its uniform during the shift.



Here’s the result so far: a yellow sun tee, a turquoise wave tee, a mint frame for home cards and a sunset palette. We’re planning My City as a one-time US$0.99 cosmetic pack. This is the preview. There’s nothing to buy yet, and the careers, lessons and lemonade stand stay free.



I’m curious which one still reads at phone size: the little sun or the big wave?
